newsitem.title: USA: NRC official fined for leaking investigation.
newsitem.headline: NRC official fined for leaking investigation.

text.p: A former Nuclear Regulatory Commission official on Friday was ordered to pay a $5,000 fine for giving a Maine nuclear plant confidential information from a criminal investigation.
The official, Edouard Trottier, 54, was the NRC's project manager for the Maine Yankee plant.

He pleaded guilty in March to leaking to Maine Yankee four pages from an investigation into whether plant officials fraudulently manipulated a safety test used to justify a power increase in the late 1980s.
